facts.text: Feasibility study by MCM Architects Inc., dated May 27, 2009, issued as Appendix J to City of Winnipeg RFP No. 181-2015.

Purpose: define options for a barrier-free elevator and barrier-free washroom in the existing Fort Rouge Leisure Centre and St. James Civic Centre. The study says the buildings 'were never planned with barrier free access'.

Scope: review the existing Manitoba Building Code, the City's Universal Design Policy and Accessibility Design Standards to confirm applicable requirements on the existing properties. Prepare probable cost estimates.

The elevator's design and location 'shall conform to' the City's Accessibility Design Standards and the Manitoba Building Code. Washroom renovations are described as needed to meet the Manitoba Building Code and the City standards.

Fort Rouge Option 1: elevator adjacent to the main stair to the second floor, a 4500 lb elevator, located outside the building to avoid losing interior floor space. Requires relocating a Manitoba Hydro pole and a gas meter.
Code note under Option 1: 'A variance is required to locate the elevator shaft on the exterior of the building adjacent to the west property line and existing back lane.'
The existing ice-level pedestrian ramp is described as not meeting building codes. The main public washroom layout is described as not meeting barrier-free requirements.
The study frames its output as information for the City to decide whether to proceed with the elevator installation. It identifies one recommended option per centre.

limitations: The code edition is not stated in the text. Do not assume a year.
